svg.title: 压缩父指针时，必须同时累加差值
svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"压缩父指针时，必须同时累加差值","steps":[{"caption":"先记录 S₃−S₀=0，另外两个前缀仍可独立平移。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,2,0],"offset":[0,0,0,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"]]}},{"caption":"再记录 S₂−S₁=−2，2 指向 1，边差是 −2。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,1,1,0],"offset":[0,0,-2,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"],[2,1,"−2"]]}},{"caption":"加入 S₁−S₀=4，把两个分量连起来。2 仍经由 1 到根。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,0,1,0],"offset":[0,4,-2,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"],[2,1,"−2"],[1,0,"+4"]]}},{"caption":"查询 2 时，先记旧父亲 1：到根的差是 −2+4=2。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,0,1,0],"offset":[0,4,-2,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"],[2,1,"−2"],[1,0,"+4"]]}},{"caption":"现在把 2 直接连向 0，同时把边差改为 +2；关系没有变化。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,0,0,0],"offset":[0,4,2,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"],[2,0,"+2"],[1,0,"+4"]]}},{"caption":"若又声称 S₂−S₀=3，就与已有差值 2 矛盾，返回 false。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"parent":[0,0,0,0],"offset":[0,4,2,0],"edges":[[3,0,"0"],[2,0,"+2"],[1,0,"+4"]]}}]}

g.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: 压缩父指针时，必须同时累加差值
offset[x] = S[x] − S[parent[x]]；改父亲就要改边差。
最终选 S₀=0 时，S₁=4、S₂=2、S₃=0；负月收入合法。
